areasTitle: Top areas in Jalandhar for homestay guests

areas.title: Model Town and Civil Lines
areas.body: Central residential neighbourhoods with wide streets, bakeries, cafés, and boutiques. Ideal for family visits, wedding stays, and travellers who prefer walkable evening dining.

areas.title: GT Road and LPU / Phagwara Corridor
areas.body: Convenient access to NH-44, Lovely Professional University, and Haveli dining stops. Well suited to parents visiting students, business travellers, and overnight highway breaks.

areas.title: Urban Estate and Rama Mandi
areas.body: Well-connected residential sectors with easy railway and highway access, popular for longer stays and quiet family accommodations.

seasonParagraphs: October to March brings crisp, pleasant Punjab weather—peak season for weddings, NRI family visits, and Lohri celebrations. Book early and confirm heating or extra blankets for December and January nights.
April to June is warm and sunny; prioritise air-conditioned bedrooms and shaded parking if you are driving through during midday.
July to September brings monsoon showers across the Doaba plains, turning the surrounding fields lush green.
